technical_quality: Adequate PA film; L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation. Good inspiration, slight rotation, lung apices partly obscured by clavicles/soft tissue. Mildly low contrast, but pleural surfaces and costophrenic angles are assessable.

devices.type: Median sternotomy wires (multiple metallic densities along the midline, from ~T3 to lower sternum), consistent with prior cardiac surgery
Small metallic density, likely surgical clip / retained wire fragment
devices.location: Midline, upper abdomen below the diaphragm at the bottom edge of the film

devices.type: External lead markers 'L' and 'HB' (radiographer side marker)
devices.location: Image upper right corner (patient's left upper chest, outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: Band-like pleural thickening along the lateral chest wall with small irregular calcified densities (suggesting calcified pleural plaque); mild blunting of the costophrenic angle
Pleural thickening along the lateral lower chest wall near the costophrenic angle with tiny calcific densities; mild costophrenic angle blunting
Mild cardiomegaly (cardiothoracic ratio ~0.5-0.55) with prominent left ventricular contour
Unfolded / tortuous thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob, age-related
Possible degenerative change of the right glenohumeral joint (irregular humeral head contour) - uncertain

description_zh: 胸部X光正面像（PA）顯示兩側下肺野外側胸壁沿線可見帶狀肋膜增厚，以左側較為明顯，並伴有數處小的不規則鈣化影，兩側肋膈角輕度鈍化，疑為鈣化性肋膜斑塊。心影略為擴大，胸主動脈迂曲且主動脈結突出，屬年齡相關變化。正中線可見多枚胸骨縫線，符合曾接受正中胸骨切開術（心臟手術）之病史；未見胸管或引流管。兩肺野未見明顯實質浸潤、結節或氣胸，右肩關節疑有退化性變化。
